text:
maria: CI red on main, flaky in TestRetryWindow again. Failing intermittently in the serve retry ordering checks. cc @aj @devon
aj: link to the failing job?
ci-bot: Job #4821 failed: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/4821 — test: runtime/serve.TestRetryWindow — log excerpt below
ci-bot: ```
--- FAIL: TestRetryWindow (0.12s)
    window_test.go:78: expected events [start retry commit], got [start commit retry]
    goroutine 23 [running]:
    .../runtime/serve/window.go:142 +0x1a3
```
maria: here's the stack and a short log snapshot — looks like a reorder between commit and retry on the same session id. Happens ~1/20 runs locally with quick reruns.
devon: can you try running with `CI_DEBUG=1` and `TEST_SEED=4242`? if it's nondet seeding we might reproduce faster. also can we pin `kv-cache` off for a run?
maria: trying `make test TEST=TestRetryWindow RERUNS=10 TEST_SEED=4242` now, will share results in ~5m
sam: if it's a timing window, adding a tiny sleep around commit in the test often confirms it's a race (dont land the sleep).
natalie: please don't push sleeps into master tests, let's only use sleeps locally for triage.
ci-bot: Rerun queued by maria: #4822 (debug build) — https://ci.internal/redwood/job/4822
ci-bot: Rerun results: 3 runs — pass, pass, fail (1/3 failed). log: same reorder.
aj: thanks. 1/3 is classic flaky. can we bisect commits? last green was at 3135700000 (yesterday). any big infra change?
devon: infra change: executor socket backlog patch landed earlier today. but that affects scheduling, could explain reorder. i'll run the bisect script across the commit range + run 50 seeds per commit. command: `scripts/bisect_flake.sh --test TestRetryWindow --from 3135700000 --to 3135790000 --seeds 1..100`
maria: If devon needs help, I can run the first few commits locally, I have the repro environment set up.
devon: starting bisect now, will post intermediate failures. ETA ~30-45m. if it narrows to infra patch we'll ask infra to revert.
sam: also attaching a minimal reproducer I hacked that prints event timestamps — might help narrow whether it's scheduling vs logic: ```go
func TestSmallRepro(t *testing.T) {
  // create session
  // send start
  // race commit vs retry goroutines
  // print order and timestamps
}
```
maria: nice — that instrumented output should make it obvious. thanks.
ci-bot: Bisect run started (id: bisect-117). 0/24 commits tested.
devon: bisect found first failing commit: 3135735123 — patches around executor socket backlog and session wake ordering. filing a quick PR to revert the ordering change and add a targeted unit test.
aj: file the PR and mark it semver-patch with `[ci skip]`? no `[ci skip]` — we need CI. :)
maria: PR up: https://git.redwood/repo/compare/PR-411 — reverts the session wake ordering change and adds `TestRetryWindowRepro`. requesting review from @devon @aj.
natalie: also add a regression test that runs 200 seeds in CI but gated (only on postsubmit) so it doesn't slow PRs. good to have.
devon: approving now, will merge once CI finishes on the revert branch. thanks for quick triage everyone :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Merge queued for PR-411 — postsubmit run will execute extended seeds.
maria: follow-up: after revert merged, monitor flaky rate for 24h and if it drops we can consider a better fix that preserves the backlog perf improvement.
aj: agreed. logging ticket created: INFRA-832 (measure executor backlog perf + revert impact).
ci-bot: thread closed (bisect-117 complete).
